mapper.select: SELECT friend_id FROM friend WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO friend (user_id, friend_id, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{friendId}, 1), (#{friendId}, #{userId}, 1)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM friend WHERE (user_id = #{userId} AND friend_id = #{friendId}) OR (user_id = #{friendId} AND friend_id = #{userId})
